tagline: A blog inside your Magento store with categories, tags, authors, comments, an SEO checklist in the editor and an import from WordPress, for Luma and Hyvä.
key_features: Posts, nested categories, tags and author pages
Scheduled, featured and draft posts with preview links
SEO checklist with a score in the post editor
Meta data, robots, canonical, Open Graph and JSON-LD
Comments with moderation, store replies and spam protection
Related products on posts, related posts on product pages
WordPress import with images, comments and 301 redirects
Luma and Hyvä templates, widgets, RSS and XML sitemap

benefits.title: Content that sells your products
benefits.text: Link products to a post and they are shown below it, while the post appears on those product pages under "From our blog".

benefits.title: Search engine ready
benefits.text: Clean addresses, meta data per store view, BlogPosting structured data, hreflang, the XML sitemap and a checklist that shows what to improve before you publish.

benefits.title: Move from WordPress in one step
benefits.text: Upload the WordPress export file and the import runs in the background, with images, comments and redirects from the old addresses. Running it again creates nothing twice.

showcase.label: Luma
showcase.title: A blog home page with featured posts
showcase.text: A featured post at the top, the latest posts as cards and a sidebar with categories, recent posts and tags.

showcase.label: Hyvä
showcase.title: Native Hyvä templates
showcase.text: Alpine.js and Tailwind templates for every blog page, the comments and the widgets, CSP-safe and picked automatically.

showcase.label: Related products
showcase.title: Products in the post
showcase.text: Products you link to a post are shown below it with price and Add to Cart, followed by related posts and the comments.

showcase.label: SEO checklist
showcase.title: See what to improve as you write
showcase.text: Title and description length, focus keyword placement, length, headings, internal links and image alt texts, with a score saved in the posts grid.

showcase.label: Posts grid
showcase.title: All posts at a glance
showcase.text: Status, publish date, author, store views, pending comments and SEO score, with filters and mass actions to publish or delete.

showcase.label: WordPress import
showcase.title: Upload, then let cron do the work
showcase.text: Choose the store views and options, and follow the progress and log of each import in the grid below.

feature_groups.title: Writing and organising
items: WYSIWYG content, excerpt, featured image and alt text
Drafts, scheduled posts and featured posts
Nested categories, tags and author profiles
Different text and URL keys per store view
Preview links for drafts and scheduled posts

feature_groups.title: SEO
items: Blog path, URL prefixes and suffix with 301 redirects
Meta title, description, keywords, robots and canonical URL
BlogPosting, Blog and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, Open Graph and hreflang
Blog pages in Magento's XML sitemap and an RSS feed
SEO checklist with a score per post

feature_groups.title: Comments
items: Honeypot, hourly limit per IP address and optional reCAPTCHA
Optional consent checkbox and e-mail to the store

feature_groups.title: Store and import
items: Related products on posts and related posts on product pages
Recent Posts, Categories and Tags widgets
WordPress import in the admin or on the command line
Images, comments, Yoast and Rank Math meta data and redirects imported

works_well_with.text: Store-wide SEO (robots rules, organisation data, redirects) next to the blog's own meta data and structured data.
